edits.old: Then they hold document IDs, types, dates, counts and case numbers only
edits.new:
Then they hold document IDs, types, dates, counts and case numbers only

  Scenario: AC17 A redelivered consumed event is applied once (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed event is delivered to the suite a second time
    When the suite reads the case through the P5 contract
    Then the event is applied once and the case holds no second copy of the document

  Scenario: AC18 A retried or timed-out activity writes no second document (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given an upload activity is retried or runs past the 2 s budget
    When the retry or the timeout occurs
    Then the activity is recorded as a budget breach and the case holds no second copy of the document

  Scenario: AC19 A consumed call that fails or does not answer asserts nothing from it (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed call through the composite route fails or does not answer
    When the suite runs the assertion for that call
    Then the call is recorded as failed, no assertion is written from it and no fake is put in its place
